capabilities: Count words written per day across all vault notes
Show today's word count in the status bar
Display a yearly heatmap of daily writing activity
Set a configurable daily writing goal
Report total words written in the last year
extras: The README says the plugin is forked from another plugin but the parent's name is missing from the text, so the fork origin cannot be identified. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: This is a daily word count and heatmap plugin that is forked from
motivation: The author forked an existing plugin to modernize its libraries, add features, and fix bugs they were experiencing.
problem: Obsidian's built-in word count only shows the count for the current note, with no history, daily totals, or progress toward a writing goal.
summary: Word count tracker that counts daily writing across vault notes and shows it in a status bar counter and a GitHub-style heatmap.
